result.play_hub: FACT: The brochure (p5) and the sheets place the PLAY HUB between D, E, F and G. On the ground this is the open space bounded by E section 5 (NW), D (N/NE), C sections 2–3 (E), G section 6 (S) and G section 5 / F (W). Its centre is about 51.1045, 71.3527, about 160 m south of Улы Дала and about 290 m SE of the Айтматова junction. It is not visible from the avenue; the only openings are the E–D gap and the narrow D–C drive. On the undated Google image (content mid-2026) it was a construction staging area: materials, a crane, one concrete slab, bare ground, and no play or sports equipment or landscaping. Sentinel-2 (10 m) cannot resolve landscaping, and on 2026-10-13 the area is mostly in the shadows of G5, D and E. ESTIMATE: the open area is about 0.7–1.0 ha, not 2 ha. It is not being built yet in any visible way, and it will probably be finished together with G (keys Q3 2027). Offices that depend on it (E-2, G-16, and F-1 through the E–F lane) should not count on park footfall before about late 2027.

result.limitations: 1) I used three imagery sources. Sentinel-2 L2A TCI is 10 m: 2025-10-28, 2026-04-28, 2026-06-02, 2026-07-12, 2026-09-08, 2026-09-28, 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-13. The Google satellite tiles are undated: their content shows the clusters after the 2026-04-28 S2 scene (C1 and the TARIH blocks already tall), so roughly mid-2026. Esri, Bing and Yandex tiles are older (2024–early 2025) and I used them only for context. 2) Block and office positions come from overlaying the BI key plans, the brochure p3/p5 renders and the BI city map (K/G sheets) on the imagery and OSM footprints (E, D, B, A match OSM). Positions are ±20 m. Individual sections inside F and G, and M's exact east-façade line, are less certain. M's position is inferred from key-plan proportions plus light ground slabs on the Google image (medium confidence). 3) 'Topped out' status on 2026-10-13 is an ESTIMATE from shadow fractions in the low-sun October scenes (shadow about 2× building height), compared with Oct 2025. It cannot separate a topped-out frame from a finished façade. The weak shadow at M may mean M is still low, and M's Q1 2027 keys may slip; this needs a site check. 4) I could not establish the use of lot A on Улы Дала (pile foundations in mid-2026), the identity of the TARIH blocks south of F/G, or the cluster east of K (probably SŪNQAR or BIRLIK). 5) The PLAY HUB area (about 0.7–1.0 ha) is my measurement and the brochure's '2 га' is unverified. Landscaping is not resolvable at 10 m. 6) Distances to Улы Дала are straight lines to the OSM eastbound carriageway minus 8 m to the kerb. Walking distances are longer because buildings block the way. 7) Office positions inside sections come from the BI sheet extraction (orientation.json), not from on-site checks. 8) I did not use krisha.kz or WebFetch in this track. I wrote nothing into the git repository; all outputs are under scratchpad/geo/daryn_geo/.
